entities.summary: James Robert Belden was an American saxophonist, arranger, composer, bandleader, and producer. As a producer, he was mostly associated with the remastering of recordings by trumpeter Miles Davis for Columbia Records. Bob Belden was a composers & musicians from Evanston (1956-10-31, Evanston–2015-05-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
